privacy.intro: dzri (dzri.am) is a free item-swap platform in Armenia. This page explains what data we collect, why, and how we protect it.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.phone: Phone number (for creating an account and signing in — no email, no password)
collect.district: District (district-level only, not a precise location)
collect.items: Details of items you post (title, description, photos, condition, pickup notes)
collect.pushToken: Push notification token (if you installed the mobile app)

phoneProtection.heading: Phone number protection
phoneProtection.body: Your phone number is shown to the other party only once the giver has selected that claim. No endpoint reveals a phone number in any other case.

thirdParties.heading: Third-party services
thirdParties.resend: Resend — email (only for the admin moderation digest, never for users)

retention.heading: Retention
retention.body: OTP codes are deleted 24 hours after they expire. Items expire after 30 days. Account data is kept for as long as the account stays active.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can request deletion of your data by writing to [to be filled: contact email].

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: We use exactly one session cookie (dzri_session), and no third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

children.heading: Children
children.body: dzri is not intended for children.
